changelog: Aura AI v2.3.8 — Deep App Task Delegation, Zero-ScreenShare Status Checking & Noise Isolation
Delegated New Chat Task Creation: Voice mode instructs app to create a new chat for building websites/apps/servers, keeping voice mode clean and responsive
Zero-ScreenShare Status Checking: Gemini Live checks real-time task progress, files, and localhost servers directly via check_task_status without asking for screen share
Real-Time Task Updates: Forward modifications and feature requests to running tasks via send_task_update
Full App State Inspection: inspect_app_state reports active chats, tasks, and localhost servers
Queue-Storm Prevention: Anti-duplicate guard and streaming checks prevent multi-queued duplicate generation loops
Noise & Hallucination Isolation: Speech fragments and ambient whispers no longer pollute chat text history
